name: RaceTrac
employee_basis: Current CPO's public recruitment post describes more than 15,000 enterprise team members. Company acquisition release filed with SEC also reports this scope, including Potbelly and affiliates; older Workday story's 8,000 is historical.

go_live.description: Workday Financials migration in 2020 confirmed by Trintech's customer case study. Kainos later integrated acquired Gulf Oil into the existing tenant in six months, with a services extension signed in 2024. No exact original or acquisition-phase go-live day established.

contacts.name: Mark Gunn
contacts.title: Chief People Officer
contacts.notes: Employer-confirmed April 2026 appointment reported by C-Store Dive; his current hiring post describes enterprise talent and compensation leadership.

contacts.name: Ameet Shetty
contacts.title: Chief Information Officer
contacts.notes: RaceTrac's September 30, 2026 CIO award announcement confirms title. Prior IT leader John Lukas retired.

contacts.name: Megan Wallace
contacts.title: Executive Director of Retail Accounting and Financial Systems
contacts.notes: Kainos March 2026 customer story confirms title; Workday's public event post alternatively calls her Executive Director of Financial Systems and Processes.

evidence.reason: Current CPO describes strategic compensation and talent hiring for a 15,000+ workforce.
Relevant financial systems executive has a public professional profile and vendor customer-event participation; mutual introduction and buying intent unconfirmed.
Vendor explicitly confirms RaceTrac uses Smart Test for automated Workday regression testing.
Customer case describes reconciliation automation integrated with Workday Financials since its 2020 migration.
October 8 vendor announcement confirms RaceTrac presenting a financial-close transformation session at Workday Rising October 12–15, 2026.

why_now: Acquisition-driven tenant consolidation, current talent and compensation leadership hiring, and a Workday Rising 2026 finance automation session create a timely discovery opportunity. Smart Test and Trintech demonstrate adjacent spend but are established incumbents; discovery must establish an unmet need rather than assume a replacement budget.
persona: Enterprise financial systems owner, with CIO and CPO sponsors
gaps: Exact initial HCM and Financials go-live day unavailable; Financials year 2020 confirmed.
Direct buyer emails/phones, verified deliverability and team mutuals not confirmed.
No new purchasing timeline, dissatisfaction with incumbent tools, or Mando allocation confirmed.
Current group financial stability details are limited because RaceTrac is privately held.
research_notes: Do not list Jill Van Pelt as current HR leader; employer-confirmed reporting says she left in 2025. RaceTrac/Trintech's 2026 Rising participation is distinct from its 2024 Workday mainstage appearance. Source for expanded workforce: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1195734/000110465925101702/tm2528884d2_ex99-a5a.htm. No scores changed.
